title: Cashback Claim Delay by App
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cashback:event
| search claim_delay_hr=*
| stats avg(claim_delay_hr) as avg_claim_delay_hr perc90(claim_delay_hr) as p90_claim_delay_hr count as samples by app_name
| sort 0 - avg_claim_delay_hr
description: Measures cashback claim delay by app.
value: Claim delay shows which cashback app is creating friction instead of easy savings.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for cashback claim delay to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 cashback claim delay.
grandmaExplanation: It records how long cashback claim delay usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
